User-agent rotation config is accepted and crawl succeeds

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(user_agents=["Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0)", "Chrome/120.0.0.0"])
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result.status_code)

asyncio.run(main())
```
